subject.title: ci(windows): add native PowerShell smoke coverage for contributor commands

question: Should this PR keep `pnpm build:strict-smoke` in the native Windows PowerShell lane after making it pass, or narrow the first smoke to commands already proven stable?
rationale: Live CI proves one selected command currently fails in the target lane, and the command set changes recurring Windows runner work.

options.title: Fix build smoke before merge
options.body: Keep the requested command set, but merge only after `pnpm build:strict-smoke` passes in Windows `pwsh` with redacted proof.

options.title: Narrow the first smoke
options.body: Remove `pnpm build:strict-smoke` from this PR and land only the native PowerShell commands that already pass, leaving build-smoke coverage to follow-up work.

options.title: Pause CI scope
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and pause this PR until runner budget and Windows build-smoke ownership are settled.

recommendation.title: Fix build smoke before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the requested command set, but merge only after `pnpm build:strict-smoke` passes in Windows `pwsh` with redacted proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent overlap across CI workflow stabilization and PowerShell-safe docs tooling.
